deadline.value: Apply by 1 February 2027 for September 2027 entry (same date for international applicants).
deadline.quote: September 2027 | International Applicants | Application Deadline1 February 2027

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Name faculty of interest in the application; no prior commitment is needed, but contacting faculty is encouraged.
supervisor.quote: No commitment from a supervisor prior to applying is necessary, but contacting faculty members is encouraged.

funding.value: Every full-time PhD student gets at least CAD 40,000 a year for the first four years (from September 2026).
funding.quote: All full-time students in UBC-Vancouver PhD programs will be provided with a funding package of at least $40,000 for each of the first four years of their PhD from September 2026.

entry_route.value: An MSc or MASc is a prerequisite; strong master's students can transfer to the PhD after a year at UBC.
entry_route.quote: An M.Sc. or M.A.Sc. in a suitable discipline is prerequisite.

gre_general.quote: The requirements for this program are: | The GRE is not required.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 90 overall (old 120-point scale) or 4.5 on the new 6-point scale; section minimums apply.
toefl_min.quote: 120-point scale for tests taken prior to Jan 21, 2026 | Overall score requirement: 90

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with section minimums.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: International English Language Testing System (Academic) | Overall score requirement: 6.5
